source_text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid. The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb. The box should be safe to use, easy to assemble, and practical to manufacture.
product_intent: A small storage box with a hinged lid that remains closed until intentionally opened by user action, designed for safe use, easy assembly, and practical manufacture through additive manufacturing.
user_intent_summary: Design a small, desktop-sized storage box with a hinged lid that stays closed until manually released by the user's thumb, using additive manufacturing for production.

clauses.text: Design a small storage box with a hinged lid
The lid should stay closed until the user releases it with a thumb
The box should be safe to use

requirements.statement: The storage box must have a hinged lid that remains closed until intentionally released by user thumb pressure

verification.observable: Lid remains closed under normal conditions and opens when thumb pressure is applied
verification.condition: No external force other than thumb pressure is applied

requirements.statement: The storage box must be safe to use

verification.observable: No sharp edges, toxic materials, or dangerous components
verification.condition: Product meets relevant safety standards for consumer use

requirements.statement: The storage box must be easy to assemble

verification.observable: Assembly process can be completed without specialized tools or complex procedures
verification.condition: Standard assembly operations are performed by typical users

requirements.statement: The storage box must be practical to manufacture

verification.observable: Manufacturing cost and time are reasonable for production scale
verification.condition: Production can be carried out with standard manufacturing processes

requirements.statement: The storage box must be desktop-sized
The storage box must operate manually only

verification.observable: Product has no electronic components or power sources

requirements.statement: The storage box must be designed for additive manufacturing

verification.observable: Design follows additive manufacturing process constraints
verification.condition: Product can be manufactured using additive processes without modification

operating_scenarios.description: User places items in box, lid remains closed until thumb pressure is applied to release it

operating_scenarios.description: Product designed and manufactured using additive manufacturing techniques

Additive manufacturing process capabilities allow for the required design features
